title: Minimal polynomial of a separable element
statement: For fields K and L with an algebra structure, a ring homomorphism f:K→L equal to the algebra map, and a separable element y of L over K, the minimal polynomial of y is nonzero, separable, and evaluates to zero at y through f.

proof.text: Use IsSeparable.isIntegral and minpoly.ne_zero; IsSeparable unfolds to separability of the minimal polynomial; minpoly.aeval gives the evaluation equation after rewriting the algebra map as f.

mathlib_searches.query: minimal polynomial separable element nonzero evaluation

mathlib_searches.results: No exact combined theorem; assembled from minpoly API

lean.statement:
theorem exists_separable_polynomial_of_isSeparable
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (f : K →+* L) (hf : algebraMap K L = f) (y : L)
    (hy : IsSeparable K y) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial K, p ≠ 0 ∧ p.Separable ∧ p.eval₂ f y = 0
